Title: Verify login fails with invalid CSRF token
Steps: 1. Send POST request with invalid token.
Expected Result: Request is rejected with AuthenticationException::invalidCsrfToken(). User is not authenticated.

Title: Verify login fails with missing CSRF token
Expected Result: Request is rejected with AuthenticationException::invalidCsrfToken(). User is not authenticated.

Title: Verify login fails with incorrect password
Steps: 1. Attempt login with valid username but incorrect password.
Expected Result: System redirects back to login page with error message 'Invalid credentials'. User is not authenticated.

Title: Verify login succeeds with valid credentials and correct CSRF token
Expected Result: System authenticates user successfully. Session is created and user is redirected to HomePagePath.

Title: Verify password strength validation rejects weak passwords
Steps: 1. Send password to strength validation API.
Expected Result: API returns validation errors for policy violations. Max strength score returned is BETTER.

Title: Verify login redirect correctly handles intended destination
Expected Result: System authenticates user and successfully redirects to the dashboard or configured HomePagePath.

Title: Verify session persists across modules
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK and employee count confirming the session is valid and persists.

Title: Login to the system as Admin
Preconditions: System is up, Admin user exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page. 2. Enter Admin username. 3. Enter Admin password. 4. Click Login.
Expected Result: User is successfully authenticated and redirected to the Admin Dashboard.

Title: Login to the system as ESS
Preconditions: System is up, ESS user exists.
Steps: 1. Navigate to Login page. 2. Enter ESS username. 3. Enter ESS password. 4. Click Login.
Expected Result: User is successfully authenticated and redirected to the My Info page.
